verses.2: Hear the voice of God in my prayers, out of fear. Do not destroy my life.
verses.3: Hide me from the evil ones, from the schemes of those who do evil.
verses.4: We have aged like a tree that has been cut down; they have followed different paths.
verses.5: They will be hidden in secret places, and suddenly they will be discovered. But they won’t be seen.
verses.6: Let them strengthen him! Let them speak evil of him. They said, “Who will fear him?”
verses.7: May they be purified from all impurities; may they be free from any trace of sin. May each person’s heart be pure and clean.
verses.8: And God raised a sudden wall of destruction over them.
verses.9: And they placed him on their shoulders, so that everyone who saw them might be able to see him clearly.
verses.10: And everyone was afraid, and they said, “It’s the work of God!” But they didn’t understand what it really meant.
verses.11: The righteous will rejoice in the LORD, and He will protect them. All those with a pure heart will praise Him.
